$comment: Realms product sheet. realms seed deploys this file onto **Realms GOS Casals** only — never onto GaaS Casals, never as a union with gos-as-a-service/casals.json. Fleet file-registry lives only here (not on GaaS Infra). marketplace-frontend is DNS keep-ID (*.realmsgos.org): reinstall on the same principal is OK; do not delete_canister. Everything else: destroy and re-create. No per-stand batons (those belong on realm stands and GaaS infra-baton). Token/NFT backends are ic-tokens v0.1.0; frontends are empty certified-assets canisters. Demo realm stands live in casals-config/sheets/realms.json, not here.
